steps_taught.name: scoopty
steps_taught.description: A step where the left leg goes behind the right leg.

steps_taught.name: shifty
steps_taught.description: A step involving a shifting motion with the upper body.

steps_taught.name: key and lock
steps_taught.description: A step where the right leg goes behind the left leg and pivots on the heel.

steps_taught.name: reverse
steps_taught.description: A step where the feet move in a reverse pattern.
